summary: `licence` is hand-authored and REPLACES the generated command. Transcendence row 6 approved `licence [--search] [--ticker] [--fuel]`; the shipped command had no flags and returned the wrong document entirely — the site navigation menu. --search and --fuel now work against the real register (21 pages, 379 licensees); --ticker is DECLARED AND REFUSED rather than answered for 8% of the register.
reason: THE COMMAND WAS POINTED AT AN INDEX. The spec's path /licensing/Generation%20IPPs.php is a 47,066-byte HUB page with ZERO accordions and ZERO tables, so html_extract's page mode returned 50 site-chrome links and no licence row. No table extractor could have done better on that URL. Meanwhile root.go's own --help advertised "the licence register with gross capacity, plant type, fuel and the modification trail, searchable by name, fuel or listed operator", so the CLI described a capability it did not have. FOUR THINGS MADE THIS A REAL BUILD RATHER THAN A FLAG PATCH. (1) nepraparse.BuildGrid CANNOT parse these pages, structurally: it counts <table> but never partitions on it — no reset of Rows, of the pending-rowspan map or of Width at a table boundary — and it only reads <tr>/<td>/<th>, so the 122 separate accordions of Generation IPPs RE 2006.php collapse into one flat 708-row grid and the 122 <h6> elements, which are the ONLY entity identity the page carries, are never read at all. A dedicated accordion splitter was required; nepraparse.Decode is still used for the windows-1252 body. (2) THE CAPACITY CELL PUBLISHES FOUR UNITS AND READING THE NUMBER ALONE IS A 1000x BUG: MW (351 entities), MWe (5, the same quantity, used by the nuclear plants), kW (5 — Atlas Energy's rooftop arrays at 501.60 to 995.60 kW, which a unit-blind parser would report as ~996 MW, larger than any plant in Pakistan) and MWp (10 — a solar PEAK DC nameplate rating, which is NOT the same physical quantity as an AC megawatt and has no NEPRA-published conversion). (3) UPSTREAM TYPOS SIT IN EXACTLY THE FIELDS A LOOKUP USES: one entity's capacity KEY reads "Gross Capacityy" (split across a newline and tabs in the source), and exact key matching alone silently drops WAPDA Hydel's 17,367.96 MW — over a quarter of the register's readable capacity; and the K-Electric accordion HEADER reads "K-Elecric" while the same page's <title> spells it correctly. The modification key has at least eight live spellings and one embeds a DATE ("Licence Modification (10-01-2025)"), so it is matched by normalised prefix rather than by a literal alias list. (4) ONE ENTITY'S KEY/VALUE PAIRS ARE TRANSPOSED UPSTREAM: Fauji Kabirwala publishes Plant Type -> "170 MW" and Gross Capacity -> "Thermal (Combined Cycle)". The 170 MW is real but sits under the wrong key, so it is FLAGGED and never moved — relocating it would be this tool inventing an attribution.
reapply_after_regen: internal/cli/nepra_licence{,_parse,_test}.go and the five committed fixtures are markerless hand-authored files and survive regeneration; the command registers itself from init() so no generated file needs editing. THE HOOK MUST CALL root.RemoveCommand EXPLICITLY: addNovelCommandIfAbsent returns without adding when a same-named child exists and is not annotated pp:novel-scaffold, and preferImplementedNovelCommands likewise only drops scaffold-annotated duplicates, so without the RemoveCommand the tree carries TWO `licence` children forever (pinned by TestLicenceIsTheOnlyLicenceChild). root.go's `rootCmd.AddCommand(newLicencePromotedCmd(flags))` is deliberately left in place so the generated constructor keeps its references and needs none of the orphan-keeping that nepra-events-multipage-feed documents. THE HTML-RESPONSE HEADER IS LOAD-BEARING: without client.HTMLResponseHeader the client's JSON guard rejects every page with "expected JSON, API returned HTML instead of JSON" and the register reads as 0 entities across 21 named failures. FOUR OTHER PLACES still name the licence resource and point at the hub page — resource_paths.go (read path + read config), export.go (validResources), tail.go (tailKnownResources) and internal/mcp/tools.go — and are intentionally untouched: they address the generated endpoint, not this command. THREE SIBLING FILES were updated in lockstep because they asserted the register was not computable: nepra_capacity_data.go's licence_register_gross ledger row and the matching basis prose in nepra_conflicts_capacity.go and nepra_conflicts_ledger.go. That row stays State:"unavailable" ON PURPOSE — the register is now readable but the probe's 47,559.97 figure specifically is not reproducible — and its PublishedAs must stay the VERBATIM published string, because the human ledger renders it directly as `published as <this>` (pinned by TestCapacityHumanLedgerQuotesPublishedStringForUnavailableRows). VERIFY WITH DATA, NOT A GREP: `licence --all --json` must report 21 surfaces read, 379 entities, and the four capacity populations 361 + 10 + 6 + 2 = 379 exactly.
validated_outcome: Live-measured 11 Sep 2026 across all 21 pages: 21 of 21 surfaces read, 379 entities, 371 distinct names, zero failures, ~52 s serial. Capacity partitions EXACTLY: 361 MW-convertible + 10 non-MW unit (MWp) + 6 unreadable + 2 no-capacity-key = 379. Units published: MW 351, MWp 10, MWe 5, kW 5. kW converts DOWNWARD as it must (858.80 kW -> 0.8588 MW). WAPDA Hydel's 17,367.96 MW is recovered through the "Gross Capacityy" alias while the typo itself stays visible in pairs[]. K-Electric parses to 2,817.114 MW with its 11 modifications collected across spelling variants, and its misspelt header is reproduced verbatim AND flagged. Fauji Kabirwala is flagged transposed with its capacity refused and nothing moved. `--search Thar` returns exactly 4 entities (660 / 1320 / 330 / 330 MW). `--fuel Coal` returns 20 exact-token matches and REPORTS the 5 ambiguous cells it did not include ("Biomass/Local Coal", "Coal Water Slurry", "Coke Oven Gas / Blast Furnace Gas /Coal tar", "Imported Coal", "Indigenous Coal") rather than silently over-collecting them the way a substring match does. Bare `licence` prints the catalogue and makes NO request. NAME IS NOT A KEY and the output says so: meta.distinct_names is 371 against 379 entities, because 'Atlas Energy Limited - Lahore-Sheikhupura Road' appears 5 times and 'Hamza Sugar Mills Limited' 3 times. NO HEADLINE CAPACITY TOTAL IS EMITTED. Generation Concurrences.php is excluded with its reason (same accordion CSS, DATE-keyed schema). MUTATION-VERIFIED 13 of 14 killed: dropping the Gross Capacityy alias, treating kW as MW, folding MWp into MW, loosening the regex to first-number-wins, disabling transposition detection, REPAIRING a transposed pair, substring fuel matching, an exact-match modification rule, reading an absent capacity key as a measured zero, admitting Concurrences to the register, and failing to remove the generated command are each killed by a test. The fourteenth — removing the splitter's early return so it descends into nested <li> — is BENIGN on this corpus because no accordion nests another, and is pinned by TestLicenceAccordionsDoNotNest so it fires if that ever changes.
upstream_issue: TO FILE - two findings. (a) The Phase 3 completion gate resolves a manifest row's command PATH but never checks the FLAGS the same row approves, so both fca and licence passed the gate with zero of their three approved flags built. (b) A spec path that points at an INDEX page rather than a data page is not detectable by any current gate: the command returns HTTP 200 with a plausible page-mode payload, and only a human reading the output notices it is the site navigation menu.
